analysis.reason: 5일 연속 하락하며 RSI가 37.7로 과매도 구간에 진입했다. MACD 히스토그램은 악화 중이나, ADX가 18.9로 낮아 추세 형성보다는 충격성 변동 가능성이 높다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율이 1.50으로 증가한 점은 주목할 만하나, 명확한 반등 신호가 없어 관망한다.
analysis.reasonEn: The price has fallen for 5 consecutive days, with RSI entering oversold territory at 37.7. While MACD histogram is worsening, the low ADX of 18.9 suggests potential shock-like volatility rather than trend formation. The 1.50 volume ratio compared to the 5-day average is noteworthy, but without clear reversal signals, we remain on the sidelines.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($64.01) vs SMA5/20/50 ($65.39/$67.04/$66.99) — below short/mid-term trends, bearish.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($62.62/$60.10) — above long-term trends, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (71.5%) + current price level historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (50.9→37.7) — entering oversold, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -0.1124→-0.3673) — worsening, bearish trend continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $64.68) — approaching lower band, 7.02% band width indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($63.90) — based on 5-day low and Pivot S2 ($60.66).
· Swing resistance ($68.35) — based on 52-week high and R2 ($70.50).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low / Lower High / Sideways) — sideways range as 5-day low matches 20-day low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.50x vs 5-day average) — movement gaining strength, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear reversal signals.
